notes.title: DEVELOPMENT UPDATE - JULY25
notes.content:
Hi everyone!



It's been a few months since we released PSYCHExFUSE DEMO and we're really happy with how much you all loved it! 



We thought we'd let you know that development for the second half of Part 1 (dubbed Part 1:2) is very much underway and our radio silence is us just working very hard! (please believe us). We've got lots in store for you; juicier story bits, more dynamic locations, new threats, and loads of visual & gameplay improvements to what is already available to play in PSYCHExFUSE DEMO - we can't wait to see what you all think! 


An official release date announcement will come soon, most likely around Steam Next Fest: October 2025. 


Until then, use this doodle from our concept artist to tide you over.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077933/3775eb7f0a1a5562c45c9b47d092bcd7e3d70395.png"]


Don't forget to wishlist! 


Love,



MIZAEL

SWD & Team MoF Club
